{"body": "@phase5 next: fix the P1 carryover. bd: **sync-kjy4** (`--claim`). `git pull` (HEAD 27fe831), worktree's clean and yours. Full details are in the bd issue.

THE BUG: softDeletePeerIfPresent (src/daemon/repo/peers.ts) updates memberships `WHERE peer_id=? AND active=1`. Archived seats are active=0/member_state='archived', so DELETE /peers/:id leaves them reserved — but the join error tells operators "Resume or delete it to free the seat." Delete must actually free it.
